description: Source code for the TbDeviceProfileNode class, a deprecated rule engine node in Thingsboard that processes device messages based on device profile settings, manages device states, handles profile updates, and schedules alarm harvesting.

classes.name: TbDeviceProfileNode
classes.description: A deprecated rule engine node class that processes device messages based on device profile settings, manages device states, and schedules alarm harvesting.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with context and configuration, sets up profile listeners, and initializes alarm rule state.

methods.name: initAlarmRuleState
methods.description: Fetches and initializes alarm rule states from storage if configured to do so, and cleans up if necessary.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, including profile updates, device updates, and device messages, triggering appropriate actions.

methods.name: onPartitionChangeMsg
methods.description: Handles partition change events by cleaning cache and reinitializing alarm states.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and listeners when the node is destroyed.

methods.name: getOrCreateDeviceState
methods.description: Retrieves existing or creates new device state objects for managing device-specific logic.

methods.name: harvestAlarms
methods.description: Triggers alarm harvesting for all device states.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates device profile information in device states upon profile change notifications.

methods.name: onProfileUpdate
methods.description: Handles profile update events by scheduling self-messages.

methods.name: onDeviceUpdate
methods.description: Handles device update events, invalidating cache or removing device states as needed.

methods.name: invalidateDeviceProfileCache
methods.description: Invalidates device profile cache based on device JSON data.

methods.name: invalidateDeviceProfileCache
methods.description: Invalidates device profile cache based on device profile ID.

methods.name: removeDeviceState
methods.description: Removes device state and optionally clears rule node state storage.
